place.name: Fernsehturm Stuttgart
place.description: Fernsehturm Stuttgart (English: SWR TV Tower Stuttgart) is a 216.61 m (710.7 ft) telecommunications tower in Stuttgart, Germany. It was the world's first telecommunications tower constructed from reinforced concrete, and is thus the original modernist architecture highrise needle tower with a "basket" atop that would be built worldwide in the following years.
